fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.role.cool: Cooling Fins make the frame a Cooling Tower: each turns %s mB of steam a tick from any of the frame's tanks back into water in its Orange tank, all of it.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.role.arc_: Arc Electrodes make the frame an Arc Furnace. Each arc takes %s RF per electrode from the frame's buffer and lets each electrode work up to %s items from Orange storage into Green storage, one arc every %s seconds: arc alloys first (%s known), then anything a furnace smelts. A Storm Coil on the roof charges the buffer with every lightning strike.
fieldframe_frameworks.arc_furnace.status: Arc Furnace: %s electrodes, %s RF an arc, up to %s items an arc; the last arc made %s alloy batches and smelted %s items.
fieldframe_frameworks.foundry.status: Foundry: %s crucibles at %s K, pool %s of %s mB.
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.formed: Grand Frame %s by %s by %s: %s sides take modules.
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.storage: Shared storage: %s slots each, tanks of %s mB, %s RF (%s stored).
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.problem.too_: it is more than %s blocks on a side.
every side must be at least %s blocks (this one is %s by %s).
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.problem.shel: the shell has a gap at %s %s %s.
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.problem.casi: there is casing inside the frame at %s %s %s.
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.problem.inte: something that is not a frame component is inside at %s %s %s.
fieldframe_frameworks.frame.problem.core: a frame needs exactly one Frame Core (found %s).
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.no_controll: This rail is not joined to a Gantry Controller.
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.problem.too: the ring is more than 64 blocks on a side.
the ring must be at least 3 by 3.
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.problem.rin: the rails do not close into a rectangle.
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.program.non: no program (put a Block Breaker, Crop Tender or World Fluid Pump on the controller's top)
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.status.need: Waiting for a module on the controller's top.
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.status.head: No room for the head above the first column inside the ring.
Something is in the head's way above the ring.
fieldframe_frameworks.gantry.status.done: Done: it worked down to layer %s.
fieldframe_frameworks.starcore.lit: Starcore lit: %s MK, pressure %s%% of the field, %s RF a tick, %s mB of fuel.
fieldframe_frameworks.starcore.out: Starcore out: %s of %s mB of fuel gathered; lighting it takes %s RF.
fieldframe_frameworks.starcore.coils: %s containment coils (field up to %s); wear %s of %s.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.arc_alloy_hint: From a Grand Frame's Orange storage
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.frame_cas: Builds a Grand Frame: a hollow box %s to %s blocks on each side, with one Frame Core in its shell. Every wall casing (not on an edge or corner) takes a Fieldframe module, and all of them share one set of storages, tanks, RF and control channels.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.frame_cor: The heart of a Grand Frame: place one in the shell of a hollow box of Frame Casing, %s to %s blocks on each side. It keeps the shared storage: %s slots per storage, %s mB per tank and %s RF to start with, plus what the blocks inside add. Right-click it to see whether the frame is formed and what is missing.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.component: Placed inside a Grand Frame, it adds %s.
Placed inside a Grand Frame, it takes the role "%s".
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.role.cruc: Crucibles make the frame a Foundry: they heat up on RF (%2$s RF a tick each), melt what is in Orange storage into one molten pool (%1$s mB per crucible), mix metals into alloys in their ratio and pour into the Orange tank. An ore melts with %3$s mB extra.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.role.coil: Coils make the frame a Starcore; each holds up to %s field. Fit Field Magnets, a Plasma Injector and a Plasma Probe on the walls. Lighting takes %s RF and %s mB of deuterium (from the Centrifuge). The plasma is never stable on its own: a control program must hold it. Every %s escapes break a coil.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.gantry_co: Place it in a closed rectangle of Gantry Rails (%s to %s a side). Its top module picks the job: Block Breaker quarries the area inside down %s layers, Crop Tender farms it (%s layers deep), World Fluid Pump pumps it. Its other sides take modules like a chassis.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.gantry_ra: Lay a closed rectangle of rails, %s to %s blocks a side, around the area to work, with a Gantry Controller in the ring. The head travels above the rails.
fieldframe_frameworks.jei.info.deuterium: A Centrifuge spins Deuterium out of water, 100 mB from each bucket. An empty bucket also scoops up a Deuterium source block.
fieldframe.status.starcore_magnet_idle: Idle: the plasma needs no field.
fieldframe.status.starcore_magnet_no_pow: Needs %s RF a tick to hold the field.
fieldframe.status.starcore_injector_idle: Idle: the Starcore is not taking fuel.
fieldframe.status.starcore_out: Out: %s of %s mB of fuel gathered.
fieldframe.status.starcore_reading: Pressure %s%% of the field, %s MK, %s RF a tick.
module.fieldframe_frameworks.field_magne: Starcore: holds the plasma in. Its signal (0 to 15, full when unbound) sets the field; it costs 40 RF a tick per level while the plasma is lit.
module.fieldframe_frameworks.plasma_inje: Starcore: feeds deuterium from its tank into the plasma, up to 1 mB a tick at signal 15, with one Ender Alloy dust per 250 mB.
module.fieldframe_frameworks.plasma_prob: Starcore: puts the plasma's pressure (as a share of the field) and its temperature (20 MK a level) on two signals.
